name: workflow
description: An assistant, a planner and an executor with a plan queue: decide, plan, build, in any project.

hooks.command: node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/install-check.mjs" || { r="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; p="${r%/cache/*}"; t="${r#"$p/cache/"}"; f="This copy is loaded from a folder, not the plugins cache: put them back in that folder, then start a new chat."; case "$t" in */*/*/*) ;; ?*/?*/?*) m="${t%%/*}"; u="${t#*/}"; g="${u%%/*}"; v="${u#*/}"; if [ -f "$p/installed_plugins.json" ] && ! grep -qF "\"$r\"" "$p/installed_plugins.json"; then f="This copy is an older version that new chats do not load: start a new chat."; else case "$(git -C "$p/marketplaces/$m" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)" in "$v"*) f="The fix: git -C \"$p/marketplaces/$m\" archive $v:plugins/$g | tar -x -C \"$r\", then start a new chat.";; *) f="The fix: claude plugin update $g@$m, then start a new chat.";; esac; fi;; esac; case "$f" in "The fix: "*) s=" Say this line to the owner, then ask once with the question tool, headed \"Install\", whether to run the fix; on yes run it, then say to start a new chat; on no, say nothing is changed. Then stop.";; *) s=" Say this line to the owner, then stop.";; esac; echo "The workflow plugin's installed copy is incomplete: scripts/install-check.mjs is missing, and maybe more. $f$s"; }

owner.title: Your name
owner.description: How the agents name you in plans and messages

machine.title: This machine's name
machine.description: Names this machine in the sessions the queue starts, as in Workflow Executor 2 (lab); letters, digits, underscores, dots and hyphens. Unset, the hostname.
